title: OauthRefreshReuseDetected
description: A refresh token was presented after it had already been redeemed. Inferred, and it carries confidence: a replay is usually an attack and is sometimes a client retrying across a dropped connection, and the two are not distinguishable at the point of detection. The chain is revoked either way - failing closed on a retry costs a re-authentication, failing open on an attack costs the account.

subject_ref.description: Pairwise pseudonym of the data subject. Subject whose grant chain was replayed.

grant_id.description: Grant chain the replayed token belonged to.

chain_revoked.description: Whether the whole grant chain was revoked in response.

tokens_revoked.description: Tokens invalidated by the chain revocation.

provenance.description: How the fact was inferred. `confidence` is required: this event is produced by inference, and consumers MUST NOT treat it as measured.
